capabilities: Render progressbar code blocks as progress bars
Compute day-based progress for year, month, week, and custom date ranges
Set progress values manually with a configurable button
Sync progress bars sharing the same id across a document
Configure names with value, max, and percentage templates
extras: Docs are bilingual (English and Simplified Chinese); automatic syncing of same-id bars across a document is not implemented and may come in future releases.
problem: Obsidian cannot render progress bars inline in notes, so tracking elapsed time or quantified progress requires text-only workarounds.
summary: Code-block plugin that renders progressbar code fences as progress bars driven by time (year, month, week, custom) or manual values.
